hook: Their boat was taking on water with five people and a dog aboard.
narration: Five people and their dog were stuck on a fishing boat that was taking on water.
It happened near Winyah Bay, South Carolina, on October 28, 2026.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew from Air Station Savannah lowered its rescue swimmer.
The boat had long fishing booms reaching out on both sides.
The rescue basket is a steel cage. Each person sits down inside, keeps their hands in, and rides the cable up.
One by one, the crew lifted them off the boat.
Then the basket went back down for the next one.
outcome: All five people and their dog were hoisted up into the helicopter.
title: Boat taking on water with 5 and a dog
question_comment: Would you climb into a rescue basket hanging under a helicopter?

facts.claim: MH-65 crew from Air Station Savannah rescued five people and one dog from a fishing vessel taking on water near Winyah Bay, Oct 28 2026
facts.source_quote: A U.S. Coast Guard Air Station Savannah MH-65 Dolphin helicopter aircrew rescues five people and one dog from a commercial fishing vessel taking on water near Winyah Bay, South Carolina, Oct. 28, 2026.

facts.claim: Sector Charleston coordinated with Station Georgetown
facts.source_quote: Coast Guard Sector Charleston watchstanders coordinated the response with Coast Guard Station Georgetown
